ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The upper part of the figure is a benzene ring, the top of the benzene ring is connected to an oxygen atom, and the oxygen atom is further connected to an alkyl fragment; the lower part of the figure is a nitrogen-containing fragment, the nitrogen atom is connected to two alkyl fragments and is connected to the central carbon at the lower right; this central carbon is also connected to a chlorine atom and a hydrogen atom. There are multiple curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Then reason and count: Count only bonds between non-hydrogen atoms. There are 6 bonds around the benzene ring; 1 benzene ring carbon—oxygen bond; 1 oxygen—alkyl carbon bond; 1 nitrogen—upper alkyl carbon bond; 1 nitrogen—left alkyl carbon bond; 1 nitrogen—central carbon bond; 1 central carbon—chlorine bond. The central carbon—hydrogen bond and all bonds related to implicit hydrogens are not counted. Therefore the total is 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 12.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the structure contains a benzene ring bearing an O-alkyl substituent, plus a lower nitrogen-containing fragment with a central carbon bonded to Cl and H. Ignore all curved arrows. Count heavy-atom bonds by region: benzene ring perimeter = 6 bonds; aryl carbon-O = 1; O-alkyl carbon = 1; N-upper alkyl carbon = 1; N-left alkyl carbon = 1; N-central carbon = 1; central carbon-Cl = 1. Exclude the central C-H bond and any implicit hydrogens. Sum 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 12.

method.method_draft: First describe the image and convert it to an adjacency list over non-hydrogen atoms. For the aryl/methoxy part, the six ring carbons form 6 unique ring edges, one ring carbon is adjacent to O, and O is adjacent to its alkyl carbon: 8 edges so far. For the lower fragment, N is adjacent to three non-H carbons: its upper substituent, its left substituent, and the central carbon; the central carbon is adjacent to Cl. That adds 4 non-H edges. The central C-H edge is seen but removed by the text instruction. Total unique non-H edges = 8 + 4 = 12.
